expect.rules: Leave No Trace travel required; camping is restricted to designated/permitted sites within the park/NRA portion of the approach. On the trail itself, the Agnes Creek bridge at Hemlock Camp (south of the park boundary, in the Glacier Peak Wilderness) is out of service and camping at Hemlock Camp is considered unsafe due to hazard trees — use Cedar Camp or the South Fork Agnes Creek camp instead. Confirm current conditions with the Wilderness Information Center (360-854-7245) before going.

value.closures: Sisi Fire: Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest closure order 06-17-02-2026-35 (Sisi Fire), in effect August 22 through December 31, 2026 unless lifted sooner, closes the Pacific Crest Trail (Trail 2000) along Agnes Creek on the Chelan Ranger District, along with Agnes Creek Trail 1272, Agnes Gorge Trail 1281 and Swamp Creek Trail 1242. North Cascades National Park's Sisi Fire closures (its fire-closure list, updated September 14, 2026, gives no end date) also close the Pacific Crest Trail from the park boundary down to High Bridge and on to Bridge Creek Camp, the High Bridge area, and the Stehekin Valley Road from Stehekin Valley Ranch to High Bridge. This approach cannot be used while these closures stand. Chelan Ranger District: (509) 682-4900. North Cascades National Park: (360) 854-7200.

expect.fees: Round-trip Lady of the Lake/Lady Express passenger ferry fare from Fields Point Landing to Stehekin (check current rates at ladyofthelake.com); the in-valley Stehekin shuttle bus runs about $10/adult one-way (2026 rate, Stehekin Valley Adventures) if you don't walk from the Landing to Harlequin Bridge. The wilderness permit itself is free.
expect.permit: Once past the NPS boundary, a free, self-issued Glacier Peak Wilderness permit (available at the trailhead, no reservation or fee) covers the climb and Bird Creek camp. If you camp overnight anywhere within the Lake Chelan NRA/Stehekin corridor before reaching the wilderness boundary, an NPS backcountry permit is required (reservable via recreation.gov or in person at the Golden West Visitor Center in Stehekin).
expect.closures: Stehekin suffered major flooding and landslides in December 2025 — a levee failure sent the Stehekin River into Company Creek Road near Harlequin Bridge — with a further damaging flood event in March 2026; recovery work was still ongoing into summer 2026. As of June 2026 the Stehekin Valley Road was reported open from the Landing to Stehekin Valley Ranch, but check the NPS 'Stehekin Flood Response Update' page and the Chelan Ranger District before a trip, since the Harlequin Bridge/Devore Creek approach corridor was directly affected by the flood.
expect.landManager: The lower approach (Stehekin River Trail near Harlequin Bridge and the Devore Creek trailhead) lies within the North Cascades National Park Service Complex — Lake Chelan National Recreation Area (NPS). The Devore Creek Trail then crosses into the Glacier Peak Wilderness on the Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest (Chelan Ranger District) for the climb itself.
expect.passRequired: No Northwest Forest Pass needed at this boat-in trailhead; wilderness permits (above) are the operative requirement.
